## About
Automotive Precision Machinery, or APM, is a family-owned and operated machine shop and engine parts supplier. We work out of our shop in Forest Park, and our staff works to match the right part to your need at a fair price.
In the shop we handle crankshaft grinding and repair, cylinder boring and honing, cylinder head rebuilding, align boring, resurfacing, Magnaflux and pressure testing, and blast cleaning. We also sell engine kits, individual engine parts and industrial cleaning products, and we use the same brands in our own shop.
We are open weekdays and closed on weekends. Stop by or call the service desk to talk through your job.

## Services
- Crankshaft grinding and repair: Grinding for all types of crankshafts, welding to restore damaged journals, and Ion Nitriding Service for cranks.
- Cylinder boring and honing: Boring on Rottler machines, including computer-controlled equipment, and honing on Sunnen and Rottler hones for a good cylinder wall finish.
- Cylinder head rebuilding: Seat, guide and valve work on Serdi and Rottler machines.
- Align boring: Align boring of the main saddles when main bearing caps are replaced.
- Block and cylinder head resurfacing: A flat deck on blocks and heads so gaskets seal properly.
- Magnaflux testing: Inspection of critical internal engine parts before the rebuilding process begins.
- Pressure testing: Testing cylinder heads to find leaks and flaws before rebuilding.
- Blast cleaning: Steel shot, glass bead and soda blasting for metal engine components.
- Engine kits: Engine kits built with Enginetech components.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We are open Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM, and closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: What comes in an engine kit?
A: A kit typically includes pistons, rings, rod bearings, main bearings, cam bearings, a complete gasket set, camshaft, lifters, timing set, oil pump and freeze plugs. Check each product description for the full list.

Q: Can you rebuild parts from industrial machinery?
A: We may be able to. Stop by or call our service desk at 1-800-282-9319 and tell us what you have.
